newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover surged to 2.175 billion yuan on Friday from 878 million yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was active on Friday mainly because some market players dismissed rumours that the central bank would shortly cut bank reserve ratios, traders said.
"Rumours about such a cut made trading very dull on Thursday," a trader said. "But on Friday, some said an imminent cut was not possible. This helped to boost sentiment."
Both state banks and non-banking financial institutions, which trade through short-term financial centres or money brokerages run by the central bank, were active on Friday, traders said.
Traders said they expected interbank rates were likely to move narrowly but in relatively active trading next Monday.
